name: Dark Iron Ambassador
summary: Deep in Gnomeregan, the Dark Iron Ambassador moves among the ruined halls as an envoy of his clan. Why the clan has come to the fallen gnome capital remains unclear.

sections.title: A Shadowy Envoy
sections.body: In Gnomeregan’s irradiated halls, the Dark Iron Ambassador speaks for his clan. The purpose of his mission is unknown.

sections.title: Conspiracies in the Deep
sections.body: Investigators and goblins suspect the Dark Irons have a hand in Gnomeregan’s troubles and its mysterious super rig. For now, those suspicions remain theories. The ambassador’s presence does not prove who caused the city’s fall or what terms, if any, were agreed upon.

faq.q: Who is the Dark Iron Ambassador?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an emissary of his clan inside Gnomeregan. His precise diplomatic mission is unknown.

faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf inside Gnomeregan?
aliases: why are dark irons in gnomeregan
faq.answer: His purpose is unclear. His presence shows the Dark Iron clan has an interest in Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Did the Dark Irons help cause the fall of Gnomeregan?
aliases: did dark irons cause trogg invasion
faq.answer: No one knows. Investigators suspect the Dark Irons, but their theories do not prove who caused the disaster.

faq.q: Where does the ambassador come from?
faq.answer: He belongs to the Dark Iron clan, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

faq.q: Is he allied with Mekgineer Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: An alliance is suspected, but his presence alone confirms no agreement.

faq.q: Where can the Dark Iron Ambassador be found?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an elusive, rare encounter in Gnomeregan’s contaminated engineering sectors and workshop corridors.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may find the Dark Iron emissary in Gnomeregan troubling. His presence raises questions for gnome investigators.
As a dwarf, you may see the Dark Iron dwarf in the ruined gnome city draw attention from Ironforge allies.
As an Alliance member, you have reason to examine the Dark Iron presence in Gnomeregan.
